name: pizzapos-desktop
description: NodaPos offline-first desktop shell — wraps the .NET backend (SQLite) and the Next.js frontend in a single Electron window.

scripts.publish-all: npm run publish-api && npm run publish-frontend
scripts.make: npm run build && npm run publish-all && electron-builder
scripts.make-and-publish: npm run build && npm run publish-all && electron-builder --publish always
